_comment: Workbook exercise plant-boiler (docs/workbook/plant-boiler.md): the four point-in-time hot-water plant rules on the lbnl-boiler plant. hw_pump_dp_reset (the dataset template's one rule; fixed near-full / near-minimum bands) reads pump 1's speed and the loop DP setpoint. boiler_summer_lockout (default 65 F lockout), boiler_short_cycle (default 6 starts a day) and hw_plant_deltat all need a boiler run status (boiler_status), which this plant does not have: BOI_STA_1 is the boiler enable, 1 all year, and is deliberately left unmapped (see the data issues). They are listed anyway, on purpose: the exercise asks why CAMBER prints nothing for them. Boiler fouling needs the boiler drift family (boiler_efficiency_drift, a baseline-vs-current comparison of one boiler): since 0.98 the config feeds it through a declared reference. The boiler drift family scores every run against the declared reference PLANT__fault_free (drift.families[].reference), re-read on every run and never stored: boiler_efficiency_drift reads boiler 1's gas input per unit of heat delivered. Measured on the full subset: boiler fouling 065 / 080 / 095 +54 / +25 / +5.1 % (fault / fault / warn; 095 clears the 5 % warn floor by 0.1 point); 0 of the 13 other runs fire, and the +2 / +4 F hot-water temperature-bias runs are reported as heat-metering problems (info). The fault-free run is the reference, so it declines (is_reference); camber datasets score still counts it as a correct negative, so the false-positive count reads 0 of 14.
